text: Asha's birthday is 14 May. She's gone really into pottery lately, mentioned wanting her own banding wheel. Good gift idea.
theo turning 30 on june 3rd, party at his flat the saturday after. bring beers
Call Vikram back about the five a side tournament on the 22nd, he needs numbers by Friday

Lunch with Rachel. Her brother Hugo just got into the Hallé youth orchestra, plays cello, he's only been playing four years which is mad. She's so proud. Their mum's flying over from Dublin for his first concert on 9th November and staying till the 14th. Rachel's dad can't make it because of work, bit of a sore point. Rachel herself is back on the piano, doing grade 6 in spring.
Farid supports Spurs, season ticket holder, never misses a home game. Hates being messaged during matches lol
don't forget to post Mila's card, birthday is 5/14 and it's going to the US so needs to go by Monday latest
Gareth and Vera are celebrating 25 years married on the 2nd of August. Doing a meal at the Italian place on Deansgate. I'm doing a speech apparently.

So I was just on the phone with Lwazi and um he's thinking of coming up to visit the weekend of the 18th, maybe staying two nights, he said he'll confirm by Wednesday. Need to sort the spare room before then.

Zeynep - knits constantly, mostly socks, wants to try colourwork next. Allergic to wool weirdly so only uses cotton and bamboo. Goes to a stitch and bitch at the library every other Tuesday. Mentioned she'd love one of those yarn bowls, the ceramic ones with the swirl cut out, for her birthday on the 19th of January. Her partner Dawit apparently hides her yarn stash from the cat.
Kemal's dad has his hip op on 12/03. Kemal seemed pretty worried. Text him that week to see how it went
Fang said her book club is doing Middlemarch over the winter and she's dreading it. Lends out her Le Guin collection to anyone who asks
Must ring Graham re: his retirement do. It's 28 Feb, at the cricket club. He wants a list of who's coming

Bjorn's band playing the Night & Day Cafe on Sept 27th!! He's lead guitar, they've been rehearsing three nights a week in his mate's garage since July. Said he's nervous because it's their first proper headline slot and a guy from a small label might turn up. Tickets are a tenner. Wish him luck the day before and get there early for the support act.

chidi's wedding's off. him and vera split up last month, he only told me today when we were walking back from the match. he's staying at his cousin's in salford for now and trying to get his deposit back on the venue. said he's ok but he clearly isnt. check in with him at the weekend, maybe drag him to the pub quiz on the 12th
Sara's daughter starts at nursery on the 4th, Sara's more anxious than the kid tbh
Groceries, pick up dry cleaning, book MOT before 30th Oct
Kavya mentioned the Lego Rivendell set three times. Birthday's July 9th. Hint taken.
Eduardo Barros, Eddie to everyone, new guy on the team. Massive F1 fan, Ferrari obviously. Goes to Silverstone every year. Has a greyhound called Pepper.
Catch up with Aaliyah next week, she's had a rough month

Varun's exam results come out 21 August. He's convinced he failed stats, kept going on about question four the whole time we were at the pub. He needs a 2:1 overall for the masters place in Glasgow, which starts September 21st. His girlfriend Astrid says he's barely sleeping. Message him on the day, and if it's bad news offer to look at clearing options with him.
Mariam is fostering two kittens until mid December. Sent me about forty photos.
Dawit asked if I could send him the link to that running app. Also wants to do Parkrun together on Saturday 8th

Talked with Elena ages about chess. She's rated about 1900 online, plays the London system with white, coaches kids at the library on Thursdays. Her son Emil is 9 and already beating her at blitz. She's taking him to the junior county championship on 15/11 in Leeds. Asked if I'd come along for moral support. Said yes.
shanice moving to bristol end of jan, her partner got a job at the uni there. leaving drinks probably 24th
Jaya - vegan, also doesn't drink. Remember for the 3rd of June dinner
Rahul's mum's 60th is on May 2nd, big family do in Leicester. He asked if I'd help with the playlist, she likes old Bollywood and ABBA
Astrid broke her wrist bouldering. Cast for 6 weeks. Going stir crazy. Bring her some books round
Note: Sadia and her husband are expecting, due in March. First grandchild on both sides!
Hugo's having his tonsils out on the 10th of December. Recovery about two weeks. Should drop off ice cream.
Saw Theo at the climbing wall last night. He's training for a trip to Fontainebleau over Easter. Asked if I wanted in, need to check leave

Ok voice note, Asha rang. Basically her and Kemal are doing a housewarming on the 16th, Saturday, starts like 7. She said don't bring anything but I'm going to take a plant anyway, maybe a big fern for the bay window. Also she's mad into sourdough now, has a starter called Doughy McDoughface, she feeds it every morning before work. Kemal's building them a proper bookshelf wall, he's taken the week off for it. Oh and their neighbour's cat keeps getting in.
Vera's grandson Hugo is graduating from Edinburgh on July 1st. She's going up by train the day before.

Gareth asked whether I'd heard from Lwazi. I haven't, not since his dad's funeral back in March, and I feel bad about it. Gareth said Lwazi has gone quiet with everyone, quit the rugby club, and might be moving back to Durban. Should message Lwazi this week, properly, not just a meme. Maybe suggest a walk on the 3rd of November, he always liked Dovestone.
Kavya's birthday drinks Friday cancelled, she's got covid. Rescheduling for after the 14th
Rachel collects vintage film cameras, got a Pentax K1000 last week. Wants a Rollei eventually. Also does her own developing in the bathroom
Remind me to ask Farid how the interview at Arup went on Tuesday

Video call with Mila tonight, first in ages. She said she might come over for Thanksgiving, Nov 26th, which is funny because she always says Thanksgiving isn't a thing for her here. Her brother Theo too maybe. Flights are silly money though so not definite, she'll know by Halloween. She's started a ceramics class on Wednesdays and is making everyone mugs for Christmas, I'm apparently getting a wonky green one. Her dog Juno had surgery on her paw last week, recovering fine.
Zeynep's grandmother died on Sunday. Funeral is in Izmir on Thursday, she's flying out tomorrow. Send flowers to her parents' place.
Graham Johnson - we did the half marathon together 2019. He's doing Berlin marathon Sept 27. Ask him for his splits after
bday list: Chidi 3/14, Vikram 11 April, Shanice 2nd Oct, Emil 29/08
Fang's daughter is in the school play, Matilda, on 5 and 6 December. Fang's doing costumes and is running on no sleep.
Need to return Dawit's drill
Elena loves Studio Ghibli, has the Totoro tattoo on her ankle. Would love the Ghibli museum tickets if I ever go to Tokyo
Sara and Eduardo are off to Lisbon for their tenth anniversary, 20th to 27th of June. They asked me to feed their cat Biscuit. Need the key off them before the 19th.

So Rahul is coaching his daughter's under 9s football now, Saturdays at 9, says it's chaos, he loves it. Daughter's called Mila, she's in goal. They've got a cup final on May 30th. I said I'd try to come watch.
Varun just got the promotion! Senior engineer from 1 Nov. Take him for a pint
Didn't get to talk to Jaya properly at the party, she seemed a bit down. Her boss has been awful apparently. Give her a call this week
Bjorn into Warhammer, mostly Space Wolves, paints for hours every Sunday. Wants an airbrush for christmas
Aaliyah's sister Mariam is getting married next summer, July 18th. Aaliyah's maid of honour and already panicking about the hen do in May. Offer to help with planning.
Mental note: the car's due a service on 12/11
Astrid finally passed her driving test this morning, 4th attempt. Get her a little something
Rang Mum about Sunday. She's doing a roast, I'm bringing pudding. Uncle Graham will be there.
Sadia's on the PTA and organising the Christmas fair, 6th December 10 till 2. Asked if I'd run the tombola. Told her I'd let her know by Friday.
Chidi plays in a Sunday league, centre back, been there years. Supports Arsenal. Wife's called Jaya, two girls.

Kemal's started learning the saz. Lessons Tuesday nights, practising a Neşet Ertaş song for his mum's birthday on October 30th. Wants to record it and send it to her in Ankara. He asked if I could help with mic setup — sort that this weekend.
Emil's 10 on the 29th of August. He's obsessed with Pokemon cards right now. Elena says nothing expensive.
Swing by Shanice's with the cot on Thursday, she's collecting it after work. Her twins due Jan
Theo asked how my mum's doing. Nice of him. Also said his partner Rachel Lee got the head of English role, starts after half term. Send her a congrats card
Lunch with Vikram Thursday, his treat apparently. He wants to pick my brain about switching to freelance. His wife Kavya's not keen.
Gareth's grandson's christening is 7/12. Gareth asked if we'd come. Already said yes. Must buy a present, something silver maybe
